failure_summary.description: Follow-ups re-searched cached scopes, repeated proximity work, or regenerated unaffected domains instead of retrieving and filtering compatible results.
Code saved or reused search results under variable names that had never been assigned.
Some calls inferred unsupported preferences or altered literal values, or used an invalid midnight time string.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already directly addresses each observed pattern: retrieve and filter compatible cached results, assign each tool result before saving or reusing it, preserve exact supported values, use 12:00 AM for midnight, and avoid inferring party size or amenities from vague family context. Adding another reminder would duplicate guidance that these trajectories failed to follow.
